entries.reason: Loop FETCH WHEN 0 (HCIMDB01.cbl:221) is reached only by a second MEDICATION row: LOAD-COMMAREA stores CA-MEDICATIONS (2) after MOVE ws-counter TO CA-NUM-MEDICATIONS set the OCCURS 0 TO 50 DEPENDING ON count to 1, a subscript past the ODO count. IBM (no SSRANGE) leaves the result undefined; GnuCOBOL refuses it (register X8, bounds_refused).

IF ws-counter > 0 in GET-MEDICATION-INFO (HCIMDB01.cbl:226): the loop PERFORM runs only while SQLCODE is 0 after OPEN-CURSOR, and the only arm of OPEN-CURSOR's EVALUATE that leaves SQLCODE 0 is WHEN 0, which PERFORMs LOAD-COMMAREA (ADD 1 to ws-counter, VALUE +0), so ws-counter is at least 1 whenever the loop FETCH returns 100. branch_solver reports a witness (EIBCALEN=18) because it does not follow the PERFORM UNTIL's ws-counter across iterations (ladder-slice: a plain PERFORM UNTIL counter's bounds are not modelled); the claim rests on the program text above, not on the solver.
